exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "~to ii (I hope / It would be nice if)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～といい matches "~to ii (I hope / It would be nice if)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～といい.
exercises.explanation: Expresses hope or wish for a situation; "I hope..." or "It'd be nice if..."
